title: melicope dubia
intro: Melicope dubia, commonly known as the Yellow Mangosteen, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. It is a shrub or small tree that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, limonoids, and terpenoids. These compounds are responsible for the plant's potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress.
